context.scope: Provided-crop component class and source-trace mask proposal; not full-page discovery, physical geometry or park placement.

training.loss_semantics: Class-balanced mean squared one-hot error plus unweighted mean squared 16x16 mask coverage error; fitting statistics, not held-out quality.
training.ridge_convention: alpha regularizes summed squared errors; intercept is weighted-centered and unregularized.

transfer.scope: Provided-crop component class and source-trace mask proposal; not full-page discovery, physical geometry or park placement.

classification_detail.group_balanced_semantics: Arithmetic mean of per-source/building-connected-group accuracy across all 12 groups, including groups with no known-class records.
classification_detail.known_class_semantics: Held-out record whose expected class occurs in the fitting groups for its fold; derived independently from dataset rows, not supplied unknown flags.
classification_detail.macro_f1_semantics: Unweighted arithmetic mean of class F1 over the 14 dataset classes; zero for classes with no true positives.

independent_statistics.scope: 148 previously supplied component crops from 12 connected source/building groups; predictions are raster proposals. No untouched final-checkpoint test, full-page discovery, 20-building reconstruction, physical 3D acceptance or world generation is established.

representative_selection.method: Deterministic first coverage of each class and connected group; no selection by prediction score or correctness.

independent_audit.scope: 148 previously supplied component crops from 12 connected source/building groups; predictions are raster proposals. No untouched final-checkpoint test, full-page discovery, 20-building reconstruction, physical 3D acceptance or world generation is established.

method: Context40epochs/fourchannels and transfer alpha100 were fixed before their first real benchmark.
The same148targets/twelveconnectedgroups and same150epoch16unitMLP baseline are used throughout.
No image masks, geometryroles, sourceIDs or buildingnames enter encoder or inferencefeatures.
No fit, threshold or heldout partition was tuned to improve the saved results.
Learned encoder descriptor is generic ImageNet; its parameters remain frozen. Only project ridgeheads are fitted.
The record-average mask improvement is concentrated in63Prospect examples; equal-group and without-largest-group results are reported.
No model is selected separately for each heldout target, and finalweightsfitallrecordsare separatefromOOFgallery.
